title: Senate Democrats block $1 trillion defense bill in protest over Iran war
framing: The headline binary is whether the NDAA advances or stays blocked. But underneath, the real tension is whether Iran war powers should be resolved through executive latitude or congressional constraint — a question that splits both parties' own factions rather than just pitting Democrats against Republicans.

LF.text: Move the defense bill forward because the troops need funding and the Iran question deserves its own debate, not a hostage situation.

LC.text: We in a very dynamic conflict with Iran, we can’t hold up and NDAA as a way of assessing our current war strategy.

LD.text: There can be no debate over the Iran war or this NDAA. The Trump administration needs every tool in the war chest, now.

RF.text: The Trump administration has been very active, militarily. It’s time for some clarity of scope re Iran before we sign another blank check to the pentagon.

RC.text: Congress has a constitutional mandate to regulate war powers.

RD.text: America is being lead into another war by the Israel lobby and entrenched institutional interests.

fluid.text: Funding the military is really important

coalition.text: We’re in the middle of neutralizing an evil regime in Iran, now is not the time
